# How Much Does KIRI Engine Cost?

KIRI Engine is free for everyone to use. We've designed the Basic plan to be powerful enough for even professionals to benefit from it at no cost. But to support KIRI's growth as a fast\-paced company, we developed the Pro plan, incorporating years of our advanced 3D research to offer premium features at incredibly affordable prices.

## A Few Words from the Team

We started our company right after university, when 3D scanning was still very complex and expensive, especially for students. While KIRI has come a long way since then, our objective remains the same: make 3D scanning accessible and affordable.

That means we strongly stand for a free version that's actually usable, without ads and without paywalls on certain export formats or watermarks on your creations.
![](https://assets.kiriengine.com/cdn-cgi/image/w=3072,f=auto/https://www.kiriengine.app/static/image/pricing/team.webp?v=2a177386b05ea5a441c47b2fd63af0199d2536d9)

But like any company, we have bills to pay: a growing team to compensate, office utilities, server subscriptions to process your scans, marketing expenses to spread the word, and so on.

That's why you'll see "in\-app purchases" on your App Store or Play Store. While we now offer Unlimited Free Exports, you can still upgrade to the Pro plan for faster processing, priority support, and access to advanced features.

By subscribing to the KIRI Engine Pro, you are supporting our team's continuous work and, indirectly, all the users who cannot afford a subscription.

We believe it is a fair exchange, and are thrilled to keep perfecting our algorithms, enhancing the app's user experience, and developing new features for all KIRI Engine users\!
[Get KIRI Engine Pro](https://www.kiriengine.app/webapp/pro)
